vessels.name: Calendar
vessels.description: Calendar widget for viewing dates and scheduling. Supports month view, week view, and day view with hourly time blocks. Every view also supports addEvent, removeEvent, and moveEvent for today's schedule — use these whenever the user adds, cancels, or reschedules something for today. Today's day view starts with a 7:30 AM "Gym" and a 10:00 AM "Design review — Studio Vortex HQ". When the user asks about getting somewhere or being there by a time, pair with the map vessel's showRoute action, passing the event's location (e.g. "Studio Vortex HQ") as the destination.

vessels.name: Map
vessels.description: City map showing saved places and routes. Use this whenever the user asks about getting somewhere, travel time, or directions — including "I need to be at X by Y", "how do I get to X", "when should I leave", or any time an appointment's location matters for planning the trip there. Overview shows all locations; route shows directions and travel time to a destination; compact shows a single place card.
